title: HF private storage limit reached for bentzbk: jta-market-lake (incl. MANIFEST.json) returns 403 to runners; ml.datasets.lake consumers blocked or falling back

OPERATOR proposed more free accounts. Checked against the providers' own pages:
- KAGGLE forbids it. Terms of Use, read via rendered page: "You also may not have, control, or operate under more than one active Kaggle account or Kaggle User ID ... we may take action without notice, including banning your user account".
- HF terms do not name multiple accounts, but they ban "bypass restrictions", abuse of services and "Hosting excessive or irrelevant data", and allow suspension "with or without cause".
HF storage table: free user or org 100GB private; PRO $9/mo 1TB private.
Measured: MANIFEST.json is 33.6 MB (LFS), rewritten each refresh.
OPERATOR DECISION, popup verbatim: "Squash first, then free org".
PLAN:
(1) Lane HF-LAKE-SQUASH measures current versus history storage, super-squashes jta-market-lake, and adds a retention rule.
(2) If the account is still near the cap, the operator creates a free HF organization they own; the lane moves the lake there and repoints the loaders and HF_TOKEN use. This needs an operator act, which goes on the console asks panel.
